Extracts keywords, author, viewport, generator, theme-color, robots, lang, dir metadata

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { WasmCrawlConfig, createEngine, scrape } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg-wasm";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = WasmCrawlConfig.default();
  engineConfig.ssrf.denyPrivate = false;
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await scrape(engine, url);
  console.log(result.statusCode);
  console.log(result.metadata.title);
  console.log(result.metadata.canonicalUrl);
  console.log(result.metadata.keywords);
  console.log(result.metadata.author);
  console.log(result.metadata.viewport);
  console.log(result.metadata.generator);
  console.log(result.metadata.themeColor);
  console.log(result.metadata.robots);
  console.log(result.metadata.htmlLang);
  console.log(result.metadata.htmlDir);
}

void main();
```
